data.name: About_Description
data.value: Zabbix Monitor shows the state of your Zabbix server in the Windows notification area. The color of the tray icon tells you at a glance whether everything is OK or whether there are warnings or errors. The tooltip and the problems window list the current problems; from the problems window you can acknowledge or suppress them and open the Zabbix dashboard.

data.name: Help_GettingStarted_Text
data.value: 1. Open Settings (right-click the tray icon > Settings). 2. Enter the Zabbix URL, for example https://zabbix.example.com. If Zabbix runs in a subdirectory, include it, for example https://example.com/zabbix. 3. Enter an API token. You create it in Zabbix under User settings > API tokens. 4. Click Test to check the connection, then Save.

data.name: Help_Tray_Text
data.value: • Green: no problems. Yellow: warnings. Red: errors, or the server cannot be reached. Gray: not loaded yet. • Hover over the icon to see a summary of the current problems. • Left-click opens the problems window. • Right-click opens the menu with Refresh, Settings, Help, About and Exit.

data.name: Help_Problems_Text
data.value: • Shows the current problems, sorted by severity and time. The colored bar marks errors (E) and warnings (W). • ⟳ refreshes the list, ⌂ opens the Zabbix dashboard. Clicking a problem also opens the dashboard. • Right-click a problem > Edit alarm to acknowledge or suppress it.

data.name: Help_Alarms_Text
data.value: • Acknowledge only: marks the problem as acknowledged in Zabbix and adds your message. • Suppress for 5 minutes to 1 day, or until a chosen time: acknowledges the problem and hides it until then. • The message field at the top of the menu is prefilled with the default message from the settings and can be changed for each action. • Suppressed problems are hidden unless "Keep showing suppressed problems" is enabled in the settings. • The Zabbix user of the API token needs permission to acknowledge and suppress the events.

data.name: Help_Settings_Text
data.value: • Dashboard URL: page opened by ⌂ and by clicking a problem. If empty, the Zabbix URL is used. • Ignore SSL certificate errors: only for testing, the connection is then not protected against attackers. Better import your certificate or CA in Windows. • Language: System uses the Windows display language (English if it is not supported). • Poll interval: how often problems are loaded, at least 10 seconds. • Warning and error threshold: Zabbix severity (0 Not classified to 5 Disaster) from which a problem counts as warning or error. Lower severities are ignored. • The API token is stored in the Windows Credential Manager, not in the configuration file.

data.name: Help_Troubleshooting_Text
data.value: • The tray icon is red and the tooltip shows an error: check the Zabbix URL and the API token with Test in the settings. • "Certificate" or "SSL" error: the server certificate is not trusted by Windows. Import it, or the CA that issued it, into the trusted certificates. • A problem from Zabbix is missing: check the warning threshold and whether the problem is suppressed. Problems of disabled triggers, hosts or items are not shown, just like in the Zabbix frontend. • The configuration is stored in %AppData%\ZabbixTrayMonitor\config.json (see About).
